sql: SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text signature,CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END grantee,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) grantor,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE p.oid=ANY($1::oid[]) ORDER BY 1,2,4
